comment: 5G NR downlink at 15 kHz subcarriers to SIB1, through the Doppler of a LEO satellite (NTN) or none: cell search over a wide carrier offset on the PSS, then the SS/PBCH block tracked every 20 ms (the offset and its rate, the slot timing and the clock's rate), the grid of every slot, then three branches reading each slot in turn. The PBCH gives the MIB and the SFN, which place CORESET 0 and the Type0 search space; the PDCCH searches them for a DCI 1_0 to the SI-RNTI, whose allocation the PDSCH decodes (LDPC, the transport block's CRC): SIB1 and the other SI messages. The sample rate sets the FFT (7.68 MS/s: 512)

offset.comment: where the SS/PBCH block's centre is expected, from the centre of the samples [Hz]

span.comment: carrier offsets searched about it [Hz]: a LEO pass at S-band moves it by up to some 50 kHz

nfft.comment: the FFT the sample rate gives: 15 kHz x nfft samples a second
